crossRefs.note: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…

translations.web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
translations.bsb: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.
translations.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
translations.asv: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey; and they sought for him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance:
